properties.notes: Former auction mart, but the buildings have been cleared and the site is now vacant. It offers chance for extensive redevelopment at the heart of the settlement. Reserved matters consent for residential scheme of 65 units lapsed without being taken forward (T/20071304). This relates to an original outline application (T/20050571). Now identified as an allocation in the draft Local Plan (submitted May 2019) . It has been suggested that the site could provide much needed affordable homes and/or specialist housing accommodation in a rural location.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
